description: This MathWorks repository supplies Simscape custom libraries and utilities for assembling multi-storey building heat models and testing HVAC controls. Its README describes thermal-comfort analysis, radiator and underfloor heating components, occupancy and electrical-load effects, and instructs users to open the project file in MATLAB. Users choose building geometry, location, operational loads and controller settings; outputs are simulated heat loads, comfort and energy consumption. The example is configurable for different buildings but is not calibrated to a specific site. GitHub metadata states BSD-3-Clause licensing for the repository. Running it requires MATLAB R2026a, Simulink, Simscape and Simscape Fluids, whose licences are separate from the source code. A limitation is that G7 did not open the project or test these dependencies, so no runtime compatibility claim is made. It can test control policies before coupling building demand to energy-system models. No MATLAB project or model artefact was downloaded. Geographic coverage depends on the building geometry and weather selected by the user; the repository does not document one national stock. The related model-energyplus catalogue record offers a separate building simulation engine.
name: Simscape building energy management example
